iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PROFILE::avr
       Returns the value of a avr profile setting.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::avr ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned avr profile.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned avr profile.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.0.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
